_note: The happy-path fixture. It is not a good story and is not trying to be. Its job is to use every corner of the schema at least once, so that if the loader accepts this file it has accepted the whole language: all four condition families, both kinds of gate, every action verb, a variant, a connective scene that only falls through, and two endings.
